cohort: The study included 320 patients who underwent cesarean section under spinal anesthesia at a referral hospital in Mogadishu, Somalia.
finding: The incidence of hypotension after spinal anesthesia during cesarean section was 78.1%, with significant risk factors identified as high BMI, absence of hypertension during pregnancy, lack of preload IV fluid, absence of ephedrine medication, and low preoperative hemoglobin.
cross-section timing: During or immediately after cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
